title: Healing switch set v1
description: The body of PUT /v1/healing/switch (08.6.3-T1, 00 §8.7, rulings T33/T72): the kill switch of one scope. The server refuses scope=system with 403 forbidden_scope (only the operator ingress writes the platform row), a project scope without a project_id, and a tenant scope that carries one, each as 422 with a field detail. `mode` is deliberately a free string here instead of an enum: the mode vocabulary is checked by the handler so that `unavailable` and every other value answer 422 invalid_switch_mode rather than a generic schema failure, and `enabled` answers 422 mode_not_available while the deployment runs with Healing:Apply off. The schema is closed: a member not listed here is refused with its JSON pointer in error.details[].path. The transport cap is 4 KiB.

scope.description: The scope the switch is set on; `system` is refused by this route (403 forbidden_scope)

project_id.description: The project of a `project` scope row; refused on a `tenant` row and required on a `project` row

mode.description: One of enabled, shadow, disabled — anything else, `unavailable` included, is 422 invalid_switch_mode

reason.description: Why the switch was set, 1–2000 Unicode code points when present (a JSON-Schema string length counts characters, the same unit the column's length() check uses)
